1.consolidated_definition: Ave de hasta 50 cm de longitud, de plumaje azul grisáceo con manchas más claras, pico negro con punta amarilla y patas verdes. Ardeidae, Nyctanassa violacea bancroft.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Bird of up to 50 cm in length, with a greyish-blue plumage and lighter markings, black bill with yellow tip, and green legs. Ardeidae, Nyctanassa violacea bancrofti.
